tasks.title: Store private drafts and notes with transactional publication and public-only reads
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, store and migration Behavior, R1-R5 storage portions, decisions 4-8, 10-11 and 15, and Checks 2-5/9 at the store boundary. Pin the merged contract 2.1.0 SHA on main from the #565 2.0.0 baseline. Append migration step 7 without editing steps 1-6 or rebuilding #565 check storage. Implement the complete store lifecycle: separate private list/detail, SQL-filtered public reads with the limit after filtering and publication-time ordering, draft create/edit/update/discard, publish, add/delete notes, cascade deletion/retention, legacy public-only mutations, resolve-clears-draft and draft-aware component blocking. Re-read state and commit each write with its audit entry under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; rollback leaves no mutation or event. Call created/resolved only after commit for public publications/resolutions. Keep the legacy store methods' public shapes and runtime behavior compatible; extend only emptyManualIncidents in server.ts in this task so the expanded store interface typechecks before routes exist. Test all transitions, fixed conflicts, limits, audit rollback, clock rollback and component revalidation. Keep #565 modules and start/token-scope wiring unchanged.

tasks.title: Serve authenticated private incidents without exposing their activity publicly
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, HTTP integration, all Checks 1-9 and Completion evidence; R2-R4, Counterexamples, Security impact and Performance impact. Build the private handler and dispatch before /admin/* even without ops.admin. Reuse incident-write (admin + incidents), throttle and fixed error/log conventions, with R3 path/method/bootstrap/auth/body/existence/state order and every listed route/method/body bound. Reject visibility/draft on legacy create; legacy writes treat draft/internal ids as missing and keep public outputs unchanged. Skip request recording for the parsed private prefix for every method/status, including unmatched descendants, while retaining patterned auth-failure/throttle counters. Exercise private reads/writes/persistence, metrics, legacy compatibility and migration over HTTP with successful private-read and public controls. Document all routes, limits, audit/log actions, shared-id gaps, no internal notifications, accepted concurrency/config-conflict limits, upgrade order and backup-only downgrade. Complete whole-change checks, service smoke, performance and security evidence; do not redo #565 or console work.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; Checks 1-9 and all R3 state/validation/limit/auth counterexamples pass. Draft create is 201, private read 200, public detail 404; publish is 200 then 409 with one initial update at publishedAt. Private draft/internal/deleted/999999 detail responses have identical 404 body {"error":"manual incident not found"} and headers apart from Date. Legacy private-id mutations give identical unknown-id 404 and leave private state unchanged. Draft update/notes survive reopen, never affect public bytes until publication, and auth still works without ops.admin. Failed audit writes roll back and logs/audit/labels contain no secret or private text. Step-6-to-7 migration preserves HTTP public JSON and #565 rows. Focused coverage may fail the global gate; assess test results here.
